card.name: Right before tumor and carcinoma terms
card.fires_on: Words just before a tumor or cancer type is named, such as 'including' before medullary thyroid carcinoma, or 'lymph' and 'cell' before tumor words. Seen in carcinogenicity text of drug labels.
